name: local-llm
description: Read-only MCP tools (analyze, summarize, review diff, suggest tests) that delegate to a local LLM through Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server

model.title: Ollama model
model.description: Model name as your backend knows it (for example qwen2.5-coder:7b on Ollama, or the model id shown by LM Studio)

ollama_base_url.title: Ollama URL
ollama_base_url.description: Ollama API endpoint, used when the backend is ollama. Must be local or on a private network; source text is sent to it

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: ollama (native API) or openai (any OpenAI-compatible server such as LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM)

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI-compatible URL
openai_base_url.description: Base URL ending in /v1; used only when the backend is openai. Must be local or private

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Optional bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible server; leave empty if none

context_tokens.title: Context tokens
context_tokens.description: Context window the model is served with. Sets num_ctx for Ollama and how much source is sent
